difficulty_reason: Four canonical exact equivalences between D_QCoh(O_X), the affine-etale and affine (chaotic) module derived categories, and QC of presheaves: (3)<=>(4) via the cartesian-flat quasi-coherence lemma (flat ring maps on affines); (1)<=>(2) via the ringed-topoi equivalence with the intrinsic notion of quasi-coherence; (2)<=>(3) via the compare-topologies derived adequate modules lemma, verifying all four conditions in span: the sheaf condition, weak Serre (through the characterization of QCoh on the two sites), the chaotic covering, and the vanishing of H^p_{Zar} on affines.
